# 🎭 MysticRealm: Pinocchio by Anoosh 🎭

Bring the classic fairy tale to life with a magical, lore-friendly twist! **MysticRealm: Pinocchio** introduces a unique wooden companion to your Minecraft forests. While he seems small and innocent, his nose holds an ancient, shifting magic that can completely transform your survival combat strategy!

---

## ✨ Features

![مرده](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14983f58ba23dcd1a50bdcf7de157c758e031b22.png)
* **🌲 Forest Wanderer:** Pinocchio naturally spawns across three distinct forest biomes: **Standard Forests**, **Bamboo Jungles**, and **Spruce Forests**.

![attack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d6d5d4d56cec6d4e67da50a1da3a5687203992a.png)
* **🤝 Peaceful But Pack-Minded:** He is completely passive and won't bother you. However, do not be fooled by his size! If you dare to attack a Pinocchio, they will protect each other and swarm you as a group!

![شمشیر](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/648337d017c9086ce24af3deade063d4752c4e65.png)![res1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff968c4e229ede35ebd93f3128a3785cc3c3bf55.png)
* **👃 Early-Game Loot:** Defeating him drops his iconic **Nose**. You can craft this into a solid, reliable sword that is perfect for starting out your early-game survival.

![دراز تر](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72b08ef1463e00fad6501fd8d001885fe06c25f6.png)![اپ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34494332691030ef0cfb952ff103359bca0c0739.png)

* **🪄 The Alchemy of Wood (Special Ability):** Upgrade your Pinocchio sword by combining it with *another* nose to forge the legendary **Long Sword**. Striking any mob with this magical weapon will instantly turn them into **Wood**!

![dancing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a846de17942f475f6c9bfd81648bf3d10b29223.png)
* **💃 Groovy Puppet:** Pinocchio loves a good tune! Play a nearby **Music Disc**, and watch him break out into a cheerful, custom dancing animation.

---

## 🛠️ Installation & Support
1. Download and install the required library mod (see below).
2. Download the correct version of **MysticRealm: Pinocchio** for your Mod Loader (Forge/Fabric/NeoForge).
3. Drop both `.jar` files into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
4. Head into the nearest woods, bring some music, and start hunting for fairy tale magic!

---

## ⛔ Requirements (🚨 REQUIRED DEPENDENCY 🚨)

To ensure Pinocchio's growing nose, custom models, and dancing animations render perfectly without any crashes, you **MUST** install the following dependency:

* **[GeckoLib on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib)**
* **[GeckoLib on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/versions)**

*Note: Please ensure you download the version of GeckoLib that exactly matches your game version and mod loader!*
